records.name: Rose Milk Collective
records.notes: The group coordinates shipments of donor breast milk from US donors to processors, and the milk goes to medically fragile infants, beginning in Guatemala. The site describes no Philadelphia programs. The IRS filing address is in Philadelphia (1229 Chestnut St), but the service is not local. Out of area.

records.name: Royal Arch Masons of Pennsylvania
records.notes: The website field says Grand Lodge of PA, which is not a web address, so it is treated as missing. No page was read and no search was left. This is a Masonic body. Membership is generally by invitation through a Masonic lodge, from general knowledge and not from a page read here, so a reviewer should decide whether it should be hidden as private. IRS filing address: 1 N Broad St, 19107.

records.name: RTOG Foundation
records.notes: A cancer clinical trial network. Patients can only join a study through a participating doctor, and its members are medical institutions, so there is no public way in. The page lists a Pittsburgh headquarters address, not the Philadelphia address on the IRS filing. Batch name: Rtog Foundation Inc.

records.name: Sigma Theta Tau
records.notes: The website field names Thomas Jefferson University, which is not a web address, so it is treated as missing. A domain I guessed (thetasigma.org) led to an unrelated site, ThetaSigma Labs, and was not used. No search was left. The name suggests a nursing honor society. If it is one, membership is by invitation and it should be hidden as private. IRS filing address: 901 Walnut Street, 19107.

records.name: Sisterly Love Collective
records.summary: A Philadelphia group for women who work in food and hospitality. They offer mentoring, networking, food fairs, happy hours and workshops.
records.what_you_do: Join as a member to use the member resources, or come to the food fairs, happy hours and workshops the group lists on its site.

first_step.how: Use the membership page on the group's site to join, or look for a food fair, happy hour or workshop on its site and come along
first_step.basis: Membership and donations look like the main way in, and the page does not say whether events are open to people who are not members

records.notes: The site names events and a 2026 workshop but gives no full dates, so no last_sign_of_life was written. The /events page returned not found. The site does not publish a street address or phone number. Membership cost is not shown in what was read.

records.name: Smooth Transition
records.notes: The only contacts on the IRS filing are a PO box (pobox8396) and an email address that looks personal, so the email is not recorded as a contact. No public page was found and no search was left. Needs a search pass.

records.name: Society Hill Fund
records.summary: A nonprofit that manages money raised for Society Hill neighborhood projects, such as historic streetlights, Washington Square plantings and a town watch.
records.what_you_do: Give to one of the neighborhood projects the fund manages, or use its contact page to ask how to help with one.

first_step.how: Use the contact page on the fund's site to ask how to give to, or help with, a neighborhood project

records.notes: The only date on the site is a 2023 copyright line, which does not count as evidence, so status comes from a working site with no dates. It is a funder for projects, not a membership group. The page gives no phone, email or street address, only a contact page. Projects it names are in leads_only. A reviewer should decide whether it counts as joinable.

records.name: Soroptimist International of the Americas

records.name: STXBP1 Foundation
records.summary: A nonprofit started by parents to raise awareness, fund research and work toward a cure for STXBP1-related disorder. It gives families information, resources and a contact list.
records.what_you_do: Families can sign up for the contact list, use the family resources and newly diagnosed pages, and volunteer for the foundation's cause.

first_step.how: Register on the contact list on the foundation's site, or email info@stxbp1disorders.org to ask how to get involved
first_step.basis: Families can register on a public contact list and the volunteer page is open, with no application listed

records.notes: The old domain stxdisorders.org redirects to stxbp1disorders.org. The newest dated item is a news post dated September 30, 2026, as read from the home page, so the post's own address was not captured and sign_of_life_url is the home page. The site shows no office address. The IRS filing lists 2001 Hamilton St in Philadelphia, which is not confirmed on the site, so the in-city status is unconfirmed. The foundation serves families beyond Philadelphia.
